Unit 2 returns to service

Unit 2 of the example nuclear power plant returned to service on 25 September 2026 after completing its scheduled refueling outage, which included the replacement of one third of the fuel assemblies.

During the outage, crews inspected the reactor pressure vessel, replaced several feedwater pumps, and completed modifications required by the regulator under the updated seismic standards.

The unit is expected to reach full power within a week, following the standard power ascension test program approved by the plant's safety committee.
